name.en: International Foundation Program — Advanced Program (18 weeks, Chinese-taught)

languageRequirements.minimum: HSK2~3 or equivalent; Chinese-native-language HSK exemption requires XJTU approval.

faculty.en: International Foundation Program Center, School of International Education, Xi’an Jiaotong University

overview.en: Chinese-taught preparation for undergraduate applications, within the ordinary IFP route. Study fields are Humanities (Business & Social Science) and Science & Engineering.

qualification.en: Pre-university foundation preparation; this entry does not award a bachelor degree or promise an undergraduate place.

languagePolicy.en: The official programme title explicitly states Chinese-taught. HSK2~3 or equivalent; native-Chinese HSK exemption requires XJTU approval.

curriculumHighlights.en: Foundational Chinese, discipline-specific academic Chinese, core-subject knowledge and intercultural communication.
Small classes based on intended major and current Chinese proficiency, with visa, application, scholarship-policy and university-life guidance.

eligibility.en: Under 24 years old and in good health. Applicants under 18 require guardian authorization.
Hold a valid ordinary foreign passport.
High-school/senior-secondary diploma or equivalent. Graduating students may apply using the transcript of a mock examination, as stated in the official guide.
The International Foundation Program (IFP) requires an average high-school grade of 60%. The separate “1+4” Foundation-Bachelor pathway requires 70% and its own undergraduate assessment.
HSK2~3 or equivalent. A Chinese-native-language exemption from HSK requires XJTU approval.

applicationMaterials.en: Scanned valid ordinary foreign passport.
Original and notarized copies of the senior-high-school graduation diploma, in Chinese or English.
Original and notarized copies of high-school academic transcripts and University Entrance Examination transcripts, including courses and scores.
Chinese-language certificate such as HSK or HSKK. A Chinese-native-language applicant is exempt from the HSK requirement only upon XJTU approval.
Recommendation letter from the high-school headmaster or a teacher, with the referee’s signature, email address and telephone number.
Study plan in Chinese or English, at least 600 characters or words.
Foreigner Physical Examination Record, completed in Chinese or English with every required examination. Incomplete forms or forms without a doctor’s signature or hospital seal are invalid.
Non-criminal record specifying its expiration date.
Other supporting documents, if any. Under-18 applicants must also supply the guardian authorization required by the eligibility section.
All documents must be complete, authentic and accurate, and may be submitted in Chinese or English. Submit through the online system only; paper applications are not accepted.

notes.en: The Advanced Program starts in February 2027 and lasts 18 weeks. Confirm the exact registration date with XJTU. Tuition is CNY13,800 for the full programme in either Humanities (Business and Social Science) or Science and Engineering. The ordinary International Foundation Program (IFP) requires an average high-school grade of 60%. The separate “1+4” Foundation-Bachelor pathway requires 70% and comprehensive undergraduate review and interview. That pathway's conditional undergraduate admission also requires successful foundation completion, Chinese proficiency equivalent to HSK4 and a qualifying CSCA report. Ordinary IFP students apply for a bachelor programme during foundation study and participate in the undergraduate review; foundation enrollment does not guarantee a bachelor place. The language requirement for this advanced route is HSK2~3 or equivalent. A Chinese-native-language HSK exemption requires XJTU approval. The standard application fee is CNY500. Applicants for the “Five Central Asian Countries” International Student Education and Training Program Scholarship pay CNY800 instead. The application fee is non-refundable regardless of admission outcome; payment becomes available in the system after initial review. Graduating applicants may apply with mock-examination transcripts. The document checklist also requests the original and notarized diploma and entrance-examination transcripts; confirm the required timing and acceptable substitutions with XJTU. Submit a complete, authentic and accurate application online in Chinese or English; paper applications are not accepted. Under-18 applicants need guardian authorization. Classes are small and grouped by intended major and current Chinese proficiency. Study covers general and academic Chinese, core subjects and intercultural skills, with visa, application, scholarship-policy and university-life guidance.
